notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the page title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are absent.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but there is no description field.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but description is unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but the UI offers “Save anyway” and creates another bookmark instead of editing the existing one.
REF-BM-07: List items expose title and tags but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and note, but no description exists to search.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results have a fixed newest-first order, with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is escaped and rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot functionality exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot functionality exists.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: Permanent deletion exists, but there is no reversible archive operation to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No display-related personal settings are available.
